question_cn: 腾挪（Clearance）战术的核心机制是什么？
question_en: What is the core mechanism of the clearance tactic?

options.text_cn: 把己方棋子插入对方两子之间，切断它们的协同联系
options.text_en: Insert one of your pieces between two enemy pieces to cut their coordination

options.text_cn: 主动移走己方占据某格或某条线的棋子，为另一个己方棋子清出攻击路径
options.text_en: Move one of your pieces away from a square or line to clear an attack route for another of your pieces

options.text_cn: 牺牲子力引诱对方棋子走到不利位置，再实施叉击
options.text_en: Sacrifice material to lure an enemy piece onto an unfavorable square, then fork it

options.text_cn: 移走己方棋子，暴露其身后棋子的攻击线（闪击）
options.text_en: Move one of your pieces to reveal the attack line of a piece behind it (a discovered attack)

explanation_cn: 腾挪的本质是「清路」：己方某个棋子占着一格或一条线，挡住了另一个己方棋子的最佳路径，通过主动移走（甚至牺牲）这个棋子，让后方棋子畅通无阻地发挥威力。本题Bd6+象腾挪离开c5，清开d4-a7斜线，Qa7#将杀。
explanation_en: Clearance removes one of your own pieces that is occupying a square or line needed by another piece, allowing that piece to use the newly opened route. The clearing piece may even be sacrificed. Here, Bd6+ moves the bishop away from c5, opening the d4-a7 diagonal for Qa7#.
